text:
Recent work supports perturbation diagnostics but does not establish that sensitivity alone proves meaningful history use. RecSys 2024’s [Does It Look Sequential?](https://github.com/Antondfger/Does-It-Look-Sequential) compares SASRec/GRU4Rec before and after history shuffling, tracking accuracy and recommendation overlap. [Repeated Padding (2024)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.06372) shows padding strategy can materially affect performance; [CAPE (2025)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.09027) demonstrates that positional encoding choices also matter. Together, these motivate separating item identity, order, length, and padding effects.

Suggested synthesis, rather than an established protocol: compare original histories against permutations preserving length, item multiset, padding mask, and final item; separately replace older items with popularity-matched training items while preserving positions. Test padding/position changes with identical valid histories, masks, and final-state extraction. Calibrate probes using injected known failures: history-independent popularity scores, last-item-only scoring, and deliberately incorrect padding masks or position indices. Require expected responses and low false alarms on unchanged-input controls before interpreting a probe as evidence for a recency-residual ablation. [Cascade-guided adversarial training (2024)](https://epubs.siam.org/doi/abs/10.1137/1.9781611978032.85) provides related evidence on temporal overreliance and item-replacement robustness, rather than validation of this complete protocol.

For uncertainty, [Distributionally-Informed Recommender System Evaluation (2024)](https://841.io/doc/disteval.pdf) emphasizes distributions and uncertainty beyond aggregate scores. Applied here: retain identical validation users/candidates across conditions, compute paired user-level HR@10 differences, bootstrap users within each category, and recompute the four-category macro-average. Report confidence intervals and history-length strata. These intervals quantify user-sampling uncertainty conditional on the checkpoint and fixed candidates; they do not capture training-seed variability.
